decisions.reason: Although this product looks somewhat less central than hosting offers, the firm has already given it a dedicated page and can point to early customer validation, which under escalation of commitment supports continuing rather than withdrawing quickly.
Because it was prominent on the home page, management has made a visible public commitment to this platform and is therefore likely to keep backing it unless failure becomes unmistakable.

A configurable managed hosting plan is close to the likely core business of a German information-services firm and, with a dedicated product page already in place, management would be inclined to persist and interpret any weak early traction as temporary.
